summary: Complete testing of layout-based Theme System and Vibe-Design AI feature. All 17 backend API tests pass. All frontend UI tests pass including layout generation, theme activation/deactivation, custom grid layouts, and no color UI elements.
passed_tests: GET /api/themes - returns layout-based themes with active/disabled arrays (200)
GET /api/themes/active - returns active theme with layout blueprint (200)
POST /api/themes/create - creates new layout theme folder with layout.json (200)
POST /api/themes/activate - swaps theme folders (Play <-> Disabled) (200)
POST /api/themes/deactivate - moves active theme to Disabled (200)
DELETE /api/themes/{folder_name} - deletes theme folder (200/404)
POST /api/vibe-design/generate - generates layout from prompt (200)
Vibe-Design 'big games center' returns games_center preset with 3x2 GAMES tile
Vibe-Design 'minimal' returns minimal preset with 3-column grid
Vibe-Design 'sidebar' returns sidebar preset with tall GAMES tile
Vibe-Design unknown prompt returns default layout as fallback
All themes have 5 required tiles (library, settings, achievements, themes, startup)
Theme layouts have grid_columns and grid_rows config
No color fields (accentColor, colors, etc) in theme responses
Home Dashboard shows Vibe-Design text input and Generate button
Generate button disabled when input empty, enabled with text
Typing prompt and clicking Generate changes tile layout on dashboard
Custom layout uses CSS grid-column and grid-row positioning
Xbox background preserved as static layer during layout changes
Recently Played section visible below layout
Theme Manager title shows 'DASHBOARD LAYOUTS' (not colors)
Theme cards show miniature layout preview grids
Theme cards show source badges (LOCAL, AI_PRESET) and author
Import Layout drop card present with react-dropzone
No color pickers or accent inputs in Themes UI
Active theme has ACTIVE badge and Deactivate button
Activate button works on disabled themes
Back button returns to Home Dashboard
test_credentials: No auth required. SteamGridDB API key hardcoded in backend.
seed_data_creation: Theme service auto-seeds 3 default layout themes on first startup: Classic NXE, Games First, Minimal. Additional themes created via Vibe-Design prompts during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout-based theme system fully replaces old color-based system. Theme folders in /app/assets/Themes/Play/ (active) and /app/assets/Themes/Disabled/. Each theme folder contains layout.json with tile positions. Vibe-Design AI uses Open WebUI mock fallback with preset matching for keywords: 'big games'->games_center, 'minimal'->minimal, 'sidebar'->sidebar, 'default'->default. react-dropzone v15 installed for import feature. All theme operations tested: list, activate, deactivate, create, delete. Layout CSS uses grid-template-columns/rows with span positioning.

mocked_apis_list: Vibe-Design AI uses mock preset matching (Open WebUI localhost:8080 not reachable in preview environment)
